message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: Yang contracted and operated Chinese medicine department, sold Chinese herbal decoction pieces without drug production license. He purchased raw materials, repackaged, labeled, sold. This is illegal drug (medicine) manufacturing and sale without license. Likely crimes: "非法经营药品罪" (illegal drug business) or "非法生产、销售药品罪". Under Chinese law, Article 141 of Criminal Law: illegal manufacturing, processing, or selling of medicines without license. Also "非法经营药品罪" (Article 141). Also possibly "伪造、变造药品包装、标签罪"? He used false labels? He used packaging and labels from other company, possibly false. But the facts: He used packaging and labels of other company, but not necessarily counterfeit? He used original packaging? He used "空包装袋" and then labeled with name. Could be "非法经营药品" only. Also "无证经营药品罪". Also "非法生产、销售药品罪". The law: Article 141: "非法生产、销售药品罪" includes manufacturing without license, selling without license. So the appropriate charge: "非法生产、销售药品罪". Also maybe "非法经营药品罪" is same. In Chinese criminal law, there is "非法经营药品罪" (Article 141). So we list that.

Thus answer: [罪名]非法生产、销售药品罪<eoa>
